verdict.rationale: Canva exposes a broad programmatic surface. The Connect APIs create and sync assets, designs and comments, and support Brand Template autofill, bulk creation, resizing, and send-to-platform. The official MCP server covers design generation, natural-language editing, discovery, export, asset and brand management, and comments. Admin, SCIM and audit-log APIs handle team management. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, though: editing is limited to targeted natural-language modifications, the Apps SDK runs inside the editor rather than as a headless API, and some capabilities are plan-gated (resize is Pro and above; private integrations require Enterprise). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, element-level design editing via an external API, ungated access to all features across plans, and hands-on or independent corroboration of coverage.
